text:
Maria: Quick ask — webinar Apr 14. We need a tight 2-panel benchmark visual for the keynote and a short launch post. Panel A: cost per 1k tokens vs model variant (bars) with throughput overlay (line). Panel B: p95 latency at 512 tokens across Hosted / Dedicated / Private tiers. Can we get a first draft by EOD?

Alyssa: on it. can we make the headline about predictable latency + measurable unit cost? e.g. 'Predictable latency, controllable cost' — short and punchy.

Raj: I can wire up the charts once I have the CSV. do we want absolute $ or normalized %? i prefer absolute $ (cost/1k) and a small inset showing % change vs baseline.

perf-bot: CSV uploaded: s3://redwood-perf/benchmarks/webinar_512_2026-03-21.csv — includes throughput, p50/p95/p99, cost_per_1k.

Maria: perfect, thanks @perf-bot. Raj — absolute $ for main chart, add a 2-row annotation: (1) caching delta (2) fallback-to-smaller model delta.

Sam: small product note — audience will care about tradeoffs. please call out: 'If you need sub-50ms p95, choose Dedicated; Hosted hits 60-80ms but costs ~30% less for typical query mix.' that way it's practical.

Priya: for inbound routing, recommend CTA variants: Hosted -> 'Estimate cost for your traffic' form (asks qps, avg tokens, privacy needs), Dedicated/Private -> 'Request capacity consult'. we'll add a hidden field for 'expected ARR' so sales can prioritize.

Joel: draft social copy (tweet thread) — paste below for quick edit:

Joel: 1/ Benchmarked common LLM tasks: cost-per-1k tokens + p95 latency at 512 tokens. Results show clear tradeoffs: cheaper hosted tiers, lowest latency on dedicated hardware.

Joel: 2/ For builders: pick the tier that matches your SLOs — we help you switch with the same API and predictable costs.

Raj: sample CSV preview:

```csv
model,throughput,tokens_per_usd,median_512_p95ms,cost_per_1k
redwood-3b,120,200,45,0.12
redwood-13b,70,150,30,0.20
llama-2-13b,60,140,38,0.22
redwood-rtq-13b,65,160,32,0.15
```

Alyssa: love the CSV. Roger on showing caching delta — a tiny callout text under each chart should say: 'Measured with prefix KV caching enabled where applicable; real apps may see larger reductions.'

Raj: quick vega-lite-ish layer config I'll use (pseudo):

```json
{"layer":[{"mark":"bar","encoding":{"x":"model","y":"cost_per_1k"}},{"mark":"line","encoding":{"x":"model","y":"throughput","yAxis":"right"}}]}
```

Sam: also add a 1-line explainer beneath the slide: 'How we made this: same model weights, optimized serving runtime, smart routing — you control latency vs cost with batching, cache, and tier selection.' keeps it product-first.

Priya: routing notes for the marketing form: include a dropdown 'primary constraint' (latency / cost / data isolation). map answers to a routing tag so SDR can triage (e.g., latency->priority).

Maria: action items: Alyssa to draft slide wording + social copy; Raj to produce two PNGs (panel A + B) and a small data table; Priya to design CTA routing fields; Sam to add 1-line product explanation; Joel to finalize tweet thread. please push drafts to #marketing-assets and ping me.

Alyssa: I'll post first copy by 3pm.

Raj: I'll push charts by 4:30pm (need to re-run the 13b rtq numbers but should be quick).

perf-bot: re-run started for redwood-rtq-13b at 2026-03-21T16:00Z — ETA 20m.

Maria: thanks everyone. want to lock visuals by 5pm so design can produce final assets. cc @eng-ml for final verification. :raised_hands:
